y-m-25-07.title: Tirooyinka a iyo b waa inay noqdaan maxay si xariiqdu uga gudbin rubuca labaad?
y-m-25-07.topic: Rubucyada garaafka shaqo toosan ee uu maro, iyo calaamadaha jeedalka iyo y-jarista
y-m-25-07.goal: Hel shuruudda xariiq aanu marin rubuca labaad adigoo isticmaalaya calaamadaha jeedalka iyo y-jarista, adigoo aan seegin xadka (kiiska y-jaristu tahay 0).
y-m-25-07.material: Garaafka shaqada toosan y=ax+b waa xariiq (a waa tiro aan eber ahayn). a waa jeedalka b na waa y-jarista. Rubuca labaad waa aagga baraha isku-xigeenka x-keedu yahay taban isku-xigeenka y-keedu na yahay togan. Baraha dhidibka x ama dhidibka y ku yaal midna rubuc ma tirsana.
y-m-25-07.thinking.0: Tijaabinta tusaalayaal si loo helo shuruud
y-m-25-07.prereq.0: Macnaha jeedalka iyo y-jarista ee shaqada toosan y=ax+b
y-m-25-07.s.s1.prompt: Xariiqyada soo socda dhexdooda, dooro dhammaan kuwa aan marin rubuca labaad.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.hint.0: Isla'eg kasta, xisaabi y waa maxay marka x yahay −1 iyo −10.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.hint.1: Raadi meel y noqdo togan marka x yahay taban.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.o.a: y = 3x − 2 (cod dheer: y le'eg 3x laga jaray 2)
y-m-25-07.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad xasuustay meesha xariiq leh jeedal togan iyo y-jarid taban.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad u malaysay haddii y-jaristu tahay taban, xariiq aadaya bidix-sare sidoo kale ma maro rubuca labaad.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad seegtay in haddii y-jaristu tahay togan, xitaa marka lagu aado bidix weli waa qaybta sare.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad u malaysay xariiq maraya asalka inaanu marin rubuc midna.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.r.e: Waad ogtahay xitaa xariiq maraya asalka inuu maro lammaane rubucyo oo keliya.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.explain: Rubuca labaad waa aagga x < 0, y > 0. y = 3x − 2 iyo y = 2x, y waa taban (ama 0) marka x yahay taban, sidaas darteed aagga ma galaan. Kuwa kale, y wuxuu noqdaa togan meel x tahay taban.
y-m-25-07.s.s2.prompt: Samee 3 (a, b) oo kala duwan oo shaqooyin toosan y = ax + b oo aan marin rubuca labaad. a waa jeedalka b na waa y-jarista.
y-m-25-07.s.s2.hint.0: Ka dhig jeedalka togan, beddel y-jarista, oo hubi haddii y noqdo togan marka x = −1 iyo −10.
y-m-25-07.s.s2.hint.1: Si gooni ah u tijaabi kiiska y-jaristu tahay 0 iyo kiiska ay tahay taban.
y-m-25-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Calaamadda jeedalka waa ku habboon tahay.
y-m-25-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Jeedalkan, y wuxuu noqdaa togan meel x yar tahay si ku filan, ama ma aha shaqo toosan. Mar kale hubi calaamadda jeedalka.
y-m-25-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Xadka y-jarista waa ku habboon yahay.
y-m-25-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Y-jaristu waa weyn tahay, sidaas darteed xitaa wax yar bidix ka sarreeya dhidibka y, y waa togan yahay. Mar kale hubi xadka y-jarista.
y-m-25-07.s.s2.explain: Tusaale: (3, −2), (2, 0), (0.5, −4). Haddii jeedalku yahay togan y-jaristuna tahay 0 ama ka yar, xariiqdu waxay maraysaa rubucyada koowaad iyo saddexaad oo keliya (iyo rubuca afraad sidoo kale haddii y-jaristu tahay taban).
y-m-25-07.s.s3.prompt: Arday ayaa soo koobay natiijooyinka kor ku xusan iyo sababo. Dooro safka khaldan (tirooyinka safafka waxay ka bilaabmaan 1 sida ay shaashadda ugu muuqdaan).
y-m-25-07.s.s3.hint.0: Hubi safka leh b = 0 (tusaale y = 2x) meel x tahay taban.
y-m-25-07.s.s3.hint.1: Raadi tusaale ka mid ah kuwa aad samaysay tallaabada 2 oo aan ku waafaqsanayn soo koobiddan.
y-m-25-07.s.s3.line.0: Haddii a < 0, y wuxuu noqdaa togan meel x yar tahay si ku filan, sidaas darteed xariiqdu waxay maraysaa rubuca labaad. Sidaas darteed a waa inuu noqdaa > 0.
y-m-25-07.s.s3.line.1: Haddii a > 0 iyo b > 0, markaas u dhaqaaqidda wax yar bidix laga bilaabo barta (0, b), y waa togan yahay, sidaas darteed waxay maraysaa rubuca labaad.
y-m-25-07.s.s3.line.2: Haddii b = 0 waxay maraysaa asalka, laakiin kiiskan y-jarid ma jirto, sidaas darteed b < 0 oo keliya ayaa suurtogal ah.
y-m-25-07.s.s3.line.3: Soo koobid: ma maro rubuca labaad marka a > 0 iyo b < 0 oo keliya.
y-m-25-07.s.s3.explain: Waa safafka 3 iyo 4. Xariiq maraya asalka sidoo kale wuxuu leeyahay y-jarid, taasoo ah 0 (b = 0). Haddii a > 0 iyo b = 0, xariiqdan ma marto rubuca labaad. Sidaas darteed soo koobiddu waa a > 0 iyo b ≤ 0.

y-m-25-03.s.s1.r.a: Ma tixgelin haddii barta loo isticmaalay hubinta ay ku dhacdo macluumaadka loo isticmaalay samaynta isla'egta.

y-m-25-03.s.s2.line.0: Ha noqdo isla'egta xariiqda maraysa A(2, 3) iyo B(6, 11) y = ax + b.
y-m-25-03.s.s2.line.2: Gelinta A(2, 3) y = (1/2)x + b waxay siinaysaa 3 = 1 + b, sidaas darteed b = 2
y-m-25-03.s.s2.line.3: Sidaas darteed isla'egta aan rabno waa y = (1/2)x + 2
y-m-25-03.s.s2.explain: Waa safka 2. Jaleecadu waa (kordhitaanka y) ÷ (kordhitaanka x), sidaas darteed (11−3) ÷ (6−2) = 8/4 = 2. Safafka 3 iyo 4 waa natiijada sii socodka jaleecada khaldan. Isla'egta saxda ah waa y = 2x − 1, marka B(6, 11) la geliyo, 12 − 1 = 11 way sax tahay.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.prompt: Hel 3 bar oo kala duwan oo ku taal isla'egta saxda ah oo aan ahayn A ama B, oo gal sida (x, y). Si kastaba ha ahaatee, x waa −10 ilaa 10.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.hint.0: Hel intee ayuu y ku kordhaa marka x ku kordho 4 laga bilaabo A ilaa B.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.hint.1: Laga bilaabo A, hel barahan mid mid adigoo isticmaalaya intee ayuu y isbeddelaa mar kasta oo x ku kordho 1.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.ok.c1: Barta waxay ku taal xariiqda maraysa A iyo B.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.fail.c1: Barta ma ku taal xariiqda maraysa A iyo B. Barbar dhig saamiga kordhitaanka x iyo kordhitaanka y laga bilaabo A ilaa barta tan iyo tan AB.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.ok.c2: Waa bar ka duwan A iyo B.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.fail.c2: Waa isla barta A ama B. Hel bar ka duwan.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.explain: Tusaale: (0, −1), (1, 1), (4, 7). Dhammaantood waa bar ku taal y = 2x − 1. Waxaa jira hal xariiq oo keliya oo maraya laba bar, sidaas darteed isla'egta saxda ah, x kasta waxay siinaysaa bar ku taal isla xariiqda. Barta (4, 4) ee isla'egta Minsu y = (1/2)x + 2 ma ku taal xariiqdan.

y-m-25-04.title: Xitaa haddii laba isla'eg u muuqdaan kuwo kala duwan, ma jirtaa hal xal oo keliya?
y-m-25-04.topic: Xalalka isla'egyada toosan isku-xigta iyo booska labada xariiq (hal xal, mid la'aan, aan dhammaad lahayn)
y-m-25-04.goal: Fahan in laba isla'eg oo toosan oo u muuqda kuwo kala duwan ay noqon karaan isla xariiq, kala sooc xaaladaha tirada xalalku ku xidhan tahay joogto, oo adigu naftaada samee isla'egyada isla xariiqda.
y-m-25-04.material: Isla'egyada isku-xigta, isla'eg toosan ax+by=c waxaa lagu sawiri karaa xariiq garaafka isku-duubka (a iyo b labaduba ma aha 0). Haddii laba xariiq ay ku kulmaan hal bar, waxaa jira hal lammaane xal; haddii aysan kulmin, xal ma jiro; haddii ay gabi ahaanba is-dulsaaraan, waxaa jira xalal aan dhammaad lahayn. Lammaane (x, y) oo buuxiya labada isla'eg waxaa loo yaqaan xalka isla'egyada isku-xigta.
y-m-25-04.prereq.0: Aragtida xalalka isla'egta toosan ax+by=c sida bar ku taal garaafka isku-duubka
y-m-25-04.prereq.1: Macnaha jaleecada iyo gooynta y ee xariiq
y-m-25-04.s.s1.prompt: Imisa lammaane (x, y) ayaa buuxiya labadaba isla'egta koowaad 2x − y = −1 (akhris: 2x laga jaray y le'eg taban 1) iyo isla'egta labaad 4x − 2y = −2?
y-m-25-04.s.s1.hint.0: Mid kasta oo isla'egyada dib ugu qor qaabka y = (jaleeco)x + (gooynta y) oo dhinac dhinac u qor.
y-m-25-04.s.s1.hint.1: Geli x = 0 iyo x = 1 labada isla'eg, hel qiimayaasha y, oo barbar dhig.
y-m-25-04.s.s1.o.a: Waxaa jira hal lammaane oo keliya. Sababtoo ah labada isla'eg waxay leeyihiin qaabab kala duwan
y-m-25-04.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad u maleysay in haddii isla'egyadu u muuqdaan kuwo kala duwan, ay yihiin xariiqyo kala duwan.
y-m-25-04.s.s1.o.b: Lammaane ma jiro. Sababtoo ah labada xariiq waxay leeyihiin isla jaleeco, sidaas darteed way is-barbar-socdaan
y-m-25-04.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad eegtay oo keliya jaleecooyinka oo isku mid ah, mana barbar dhigin gooynta y.
y-m-25-04.s.s1.o.c: Waxaa jira aan dhammaad lahayn. Sababtoo ah labada isla'eg waxay matalaan isla xariiq
y-m-25-04.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad aragtay in xitaa haddii muuqaalku kala duwan yahay, ay noqon karaan isla xariiq.
y-m-25-04.s.s1.explain: Haddii aad labada dhinac ee 4x − 2y = −2 u qaybiso 2, waxaad heleysaa 2x − y = −1. Labada isla'eg waa isla xariiq, sidaas darteed bar kasta oo xariiqda ku taal waa xal.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.prompt: Isla'egta koowaad sidii ay tahay ilaali, isla'egta labaad na u beddel 4x − 2y = c (c waa joogto). Sidee tirada xalalku u isbeddelaa iyadoo ku xidhan qiimaha c?
y-m-25-04.s.s2.hint.0: Geli dhowr lambar (tusaale, −2, 0, 4) c oo barbar dhig gooynta y ee labada xariiq.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kala sooc xaaladaha labada xariiq ay leeyihiin isla jaleeco kuwa leh isla gooynta y iyo kuwa leh gooyn y kala duwan.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.o.a: Wixii c ahaado, waxaa jira xalal aan dhammaad lahayn. Sababtoo ah isku-dhufashooyinku waa isku mid
y-m-25-04.s.s2.r.a: Waxaad eegtay oo keliya isku-dhufashada isla'egta, mana tixgelin eraygii joogtada c.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.o.b: Hal c oo keliya ayaa leh xalal aan dhammaad lahayn, inta kalena xal ma laha
y-m-25-04.s.s2.r.b: Waxaad aragtay in marka c isbeddelo, xariiqdu si is-barbar-socod ah u dhaqaaqdo.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.o.c: Hal c oo keliya ayaan xal laheyn, c kale na waxay leeyihiin hal lammaane mid kasta
y-m-25-04.s.s2.r.c: Waxaad u maleysay in haddii jaleecooyinku isku mid yihiin, xariiqyadu ku kulmaan xaalad kasta.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.o.d: Haddii c ma aha 0, mar walba waxaa jira hal lammaane, haddii ay tahay 0 na ma jiro
y-m-25-04.s.s2.r.d: Waxaad u maleysay in c = 0 uu gaar yahay.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.explain: 4x − 2y = c waa y = 2x − c/2, isla'egta koowaadna waa y = 2x + 1. Jaleecooyinku waa isku mid, sidaas darteed waa isla xariiq marka c = −2 oo keliya, c kale na is-barbar-socda oo is ma dulsaaraan, sidaas darteed xal ma jiro.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.prompt: Samee isla'eg labaad ax + by = c oo matalaysa isla xariiqda isla'egta koowaad 2x − y = −1. Si muuqaalku isku mid uusan u noqon, a ma noqon karto 2, oo gal 3 isla'eg oo kala duwan sida (a, b, c).
y-m-25-04.s.s3.hint.0: Qor isku-dhufashooyinka 2, −1, −1 ee isla'egta koowaad oo dhinac dhinac la dhig a, b, c ee isla'egta labaad.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.hint.1: Barbar dhig haddii labada isla'eg ay maraan isla barahaas marka x = 0 iyo marka y = 0.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.ok.c1: Saamiga isku-dhufashooyinka x iyo y waa isku mid sida isla'egta koowaad, sidaas darteed jaleecadu waa isku mid.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.fail.c1: Saamiga isku-dhufashooyinka x iyo y waa ka duwan yahay isla'egta koowaad, sidaas darteed jaleecadu way kala duwan tahay.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.ok.c2: Eraygii joogtada ah sidoo kale waa isla saamigii, sidaas darteed xariiqyadu way is-dulsaaraan.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.fail.c2: Saamiga isku-dhufashooyinku waa sax laakiin eraygii joogtada ah ma ahan saamigaas, sidaas darteed waa xariiq kale oo is-barbar-socota.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.ok.c3: Muuqaalkeedu wuu ka duwan yahay isla'egta koowaad.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.fail.c3: a waa 2 ama 0. Muuqaalkeedu wuu la mid yahay isla'egta koowaad, ama ma samayso xariiq.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.explain: Tusaale: (4, −2, −2), (−2, 1, 1), (6, −3, −3). Haddii saddexda lambar ee isla'egta labaad ay yihiin saddexda lambar (2, −1, −1) ee isla'egta koowaad oo lagu dhuftay isla lambar, labada isla'eg waa isla xariiq. Haddii xitaa hal lambar ka leexdo saamigaas, ma aha isla xariiq.

y-m-25-05.title: Ma kan leh lambarka jaleecada ka weyn ayaa dhakhso badan?
y-m-25-05.topic: Akhrinta jaleecada garaafka: barbar dhigga laba garaaf oo leh cutubyo kala duwan
y-m-25-05.goal: Fahan in jaleecada lagu akhriyo cutubyadeeda, oo barbar dhig laba garaaf oo leh cutubyo kala duwan adigoo u beddelaya isla cutubyada.
y-m-25-05.material: Doyun iyo Seoa mid kasta wuu socday oo diiwaankiisii wuxuu ku sawiray garaaf. Garaafka Doyun wuxuu leeyahay waqtiga (daqiiqado) dhidibka siman iyo masaafada la socday (m) dhidibka toosan, wuxuuna yahay xariiq toosan oo maraysa asalka (0, 0) iyo barta (10, 700). Garaafka Seoa wuxuu leeyahay waqtiga (saacadood) dhidibka siman iyo masaafada la socday (km) dhidibka toosan, wuxuuna yahay xariiq toosan oo maraysa asalka iyo barta (2, 10).
y-m-25-05.thinking.1: U beddelida isla cutubyada si loo barbar dhigo
y-m-25-05.thinking.2: Ogaanshaha malo-awaalka ka dhigaya barbar dhigga mid sax ah

y-m-25-05.s.s1.hint.0: Garaaf kasta, sheeg intee ayuu dhidibka toosan ku kordhaa marka dhidibka siman ku kordho 1, oo cutubkiisa la wada sheeg.
y-m-25-05.s.s1.hint.1: Hubi haddii cutubyada labada jaleeco lagu xidhay ay isku mid yihiin.

y-m-25-05.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad macnaha jeedalka ku akhrisay cutubkiisa.
y-m-25-05.s.s1.o.b: Marka jeedalku weyn yahay, waa dhaqso badan yahay, sidaas darteed Doyun, oo 70 uu ka weyn yahay 5, ayaa dhaqso badan
y-m-25-05.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad barbar dhigtay cabbirrada tirooyinka oo keliya adigoo aan hubin cutubyada.
y-m-25-05.s.s1.o.c: Marka jeedalku yar yahay, masaafo isku mid ah ayaa si dhakhso ah loo gaaraa, sidaas darteed Seoa ayaa dhaqso badan

y-m-25-05.s.s1.explain: Jeedalku waa qaddarka dhidibka taagan ee kordha marka dhidibka toosan uu kordho 1. Doyun wuxuu socdaa 70 m daqiiqad kasta Seoa na wuxuu socdaa 5 km saacad kasta, sidaas darteed haddii cutubyadu kala duwan yihiin, lama barbar dhigi karo tirooyinka oo keliya.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.prompt: Haddii aad socodka Doyun u beddesho isla cutubyada garaafka Seoa (saacado dhidibka toosan, km dhidibka taagan), Doyun wuxuu u socdaa d km t saacadood. Gali 3 lammaane oo kala duwan (t, d) oo ku habboon xiriirkan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, 0 < t ≤ 3.

y-m-25-05.s.s2.hint.1: U beddel masaafada aad heshay m ilaa km, hagaaji dhowr waqti, oo xisaabi masaafooyinka.

y-m-25-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Ma ku habboona socodka Doyun. Doyun wuxuu socdaa 700 m 10 daqiiqo, 1 saac na waa 60 daqiiqo 1 km na waa 1000 m.

y-m-25-05.s.s2.because.model.1: 700 m waa 0.7 km 10 daqiiqo na waa 1/6 saac. 1 saac, wuxuu socdaa 0.7×6=4.2 km.

y-m-25-05.s.s3.r.c: Waxaad aragtay in garaafka xariiq toosan oo keliya uu jeedalku la mid yahay xawaaraha.
